summary: Windows platform check: fills an OSVERSIONINFOA struct (dwOSVersionInfoSize = 148 = sizeof(OSVERSIONINFOA)), calls the GetVersionExA import, and returns TRUE only when the call succeeds and dwPlatformId equals 2 (Windows NT family). Called by sub_58FD90, likely as a startup capability/OS gate.

operations.description: Initialize VersionInformation.dwOSVersionInfoSize to 148, writing the version-info struct field at stack slot global:0xFF00000000005370.
Call the GetVersionExA import (0x0059E198) with a pointer to the VersionInformation struct.
Return TRUE only if GetVersionExA succeeded AND the dwPlatformId field read at stack slot global:0xFF00000000005374 equals 2.
Return the combined boolean result of the success and platform checks.
